deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: v1.13.0 -> prod-eu3. Canary targets: 5% traffic for 10m. Running post-deploy probes (embedding-synth, generate-smoke).
Lina: embedding-synth failing 4/10 probes: timeouts 2s+, errors show 503 from model-host.
Theo: seeing same in APM traces — backend latency spikes at model-host pool during canary ramp.
Ops-Kate: any 5xx from gateway?
perf-bot: gateway 502s at 2931121004 and 2931121032 (canary window overlap).
Lina: secondary check: p50/p95 for /v1/embeddings during canary: p50 +210ms, p95 +1.1s. baseline p95 ~120ms.
Theo: this looks like a resource regression in v1.13.0 — memory footprints higher on model loader.
Lina: roll forward risk if we continue. change window is short (ends in ~18m).
Ops-Kate: recommend pause rollout and pin traffic back to v1.12.x while we triage. safer than immediate rollback.
Theo: can we quickly reduce canary weight to 0% instead of full rollback?
Lina: yes run traffic-split command.
Ops-Kate: command: `splunkctl run traffic-split set canary=0 main=100 --service=embed-service --ns=prod`
Ops-Kate: executing now.
deploy-bot: Received traffic-split command by Ops-Kate at 2931130012. Canary weight -> 0%.
perf-bot: post-change checks: canary traffic removed, embedding-synth failures dropped to 0. p95 back to +140ms.
Lina: good. Now pin release group to v1.12.9 for stability: `deployctl pin embed-service v1.12.9`
Theo: pinning will keep traffic on last stable variant and prevent automatic rollouts.
deploy-bot: `deployctl pin embed-service v1.12.9` executed by Lina at 2931130050. Pin confirmed.
Lina: opened INF-4870: "v1.13.0: embedding synth timeouts in EU3 canary — suspected model-host memory regression." Attached heap dumps + flamegraphs.
Ops-Kate: adding escalation to infra oncall, tagging `instance-type-c5-large` suspected.
Theo: quick mitigation idea: bump replicas for model-host pool and enable lazy-loader to spread CPU pressure. Would that avoid rollback?
Lina: could try a small replica bump for canary backend if we want to test a hotfix, but since canary is now 0% it's safe to iterate in a staging lane first.
release-cop: updating release notes draft: "v1.13.0: temporarily paused canary due to embed probe timeouts in EU region; pinned embed-service to v1.12.9. Investigating model-host memory allocation change."
Ops-Kate: also add a note to the change window log that we paused and pinned at 2931130050 to avoid silent failover.
Theo: will reproduce locally with same instance type + conductor flags and run mem profiler.
Lina: thanks. schedule follow-up sync in 30m if we have repro. tagging infra and model-team. :mag:
deploy-bot: Canary halted and pinned at 2931130050. Monitoring: no regressions observed after pin.
Ops-Kate: closing immediate incident. will reopen on new evidence.
Lina: postmortem stub created and linked to INF-4870. we'll include mitigation steps (canary auto-rollback threshold, improved embed-synth coverage).
release-cop: final note: hold formal release notes until root cause confirmed. for now mark release v1.13.0 as "paused" in the release tracker. :memo:
Theo: lgtm
Lina: marking thread resolved for now. will update when infra repros. :white_check_mark:
